facts.fact: Morocco's digital transition minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni said on 18 February 2025 that a draft decree setting the rules for organising, publishing and governing open public data has been prepared, covering all institutions named in law 31-13.

MAR.note: The article is about a hackathon and names no body publishing data on a portal.
The article names a Technopark only as a hackathon partner and states no hub programme.
